title: The Big Brush For Buffing
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A dense yet incredibly soft buffing and blending brush that is designed to achieve a smooth and seamless finish.

Brush Formulation: Cream

Brush Coverage: Medium

Brush Handle Length: Three-and-a-half inches

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Sun Melt:
-Blend and buff onto high points of face such as cheekbones, bridge of nose, temples, and forehead.
-Move brush in sweeping motions to evenly disperse and blend product.
-Buff into skin for a seamless, polished look.

Slip Tint:
-Apply two pumps to skin.
-For a seamless finish, use the brush to buff and blend into skin.
